memory: separate process Linux VmHWM; no oracle/text/operations/output buffers; RMQ input vector plus live tree, Bitset two live operands
oracle: every timed process first checks all small nonempty RMQ intervals against scalar scan; bitsets checked at every bit after 80 operations against vector<bool> and self XOR; not merely shared checksum
contracts: RMQ uint32 value-only nonempty intervals, no argmin guarantee; Bitset exactly same N and truncation for std::bitset<N>, dynamic Bitset has runtime N; shifts B|=B<<k and separate OR/XOR/AND
order: rotate candidate order by run/case, fresh process each; inherit recorded taskset affinity
adapter_policy: RMQ timed inner loop directly calls wrapped library tree.prod; Bitset adapter set/test/shift_or/logic all forced inline; public library inlining remains compiler-controlled
